title: Add explicit markdownlint configuration
description: markdownlint-cli2 runs during `make lint-md` but uses default rules with no project-specific config file. Add a .markdownlint.yaml (or .markdownlint-cli2.yaml) with explicit rule selections so the behavior is predictable and documented. Consider enabling stricter rules for consistency (e.g. heading style, list indent, line length) and disabling rules that conflict with the project's conventions.
